entity.summary: Open-source smart-card hardware wallet using an EAL6+ secure element to keep user private keys inside the card.
entity.notes: Current first-party Satochip product and quick-start material establishes an actively sold self-custody hardware wallet whose private keys remain in an EAL6+ secure element. Initial launch date remains unresolved.

products.summary: Satochip smart-card hardware wallet using an EAL6+ secure element and current desktop/mobile integrations.
products.notes: Current first-party product page offers Satochip for purchase and states private keys cannot be extracted from the secure chip. Support status remains conservative `unknown` rather than inferring a formal maintenance commitment from current documentation alone.

events.title: Satochip applet v0.12 released
events.description: Satochip applet v0.12 was released with SeedKeeper encrypted-seed import support, card labels, offline 2FA reset support, factory reset support, and card-authenticity PKI support.

evidence.title: Satochip — Hardware solutions for your cryptocurrencies
evidence.notes: Current first-party homepage describes Satochip as a self-custody hardware wallet using an EAL6+ certified secure element.

evidence.title: Satochip Hardware Wallet
evidence.notes: Current first-party product page offers Satochip for sale and states private keys are handled inside an EAL6+ secure element and cannot be extracted from the chip.
